newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia June reserves hit $21.084 billion.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia June reserves hit $21.084 billion.

text.p: Indonesia's foreign exchange reserves rose to $21.084 billion at the end of June from $20.987 billion in May, a government official said on Thursday.
"Our reserves rose to $21.084 billion in June," the official told Reuters. Indonesia's foreign reserves totalled $20.382 in April against $19.872 billion in March.
Foreign exchange reserves in June last year were $16.483 billion. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
